title: The Tale of Jemima Puddle-Duck
description: Jemima wants a quiet place to hatch her eggs, but the charming gentleman who offers her a nest in the woods has plans of his own.
catalogueBlurb: Jemima finds a secret nest and a very suspicious new friend.

cover.alt: Beatrix Potter's original cover for The Tale of Jemima Puddle-Duck.

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on Beatrix Potter's public-domain 1908 story
text.notes: The underlying 1908 story is public domain in the UK and United States. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.notes: The selected original Potter illustration files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

rights.curatorNotes: Split into five short reader sections, preserving the cautionary shape of Potter's story while softening the harsher ending for the target reader.

text.source: Beatrix Potter's 1908 text, transcribed in Project Gutenberg eBook #14814
text.notes: Complete story text. Project Gutenberg header, footer, licence text and standalone [Illustration] placeholders are excluded; wording is not abridged, softened or modernised.

illustrations.source: Original 1908 illustrations by Beatrix Potter, Project Gutenberg eBook #14814
illustrations.notes: All 25 narrative illustrations appearing after the opening story text in the Project Gutenberg HTML edition are included in source order. Front-matter emblem/title artwork is excluded.

edition.notes: Story House pagination is presentation only; the original wording remains unabridged.

rights.curatorNotes: Complete original text split into 6 reader pages at paragraph boundaries, with all 25 narrative illustrations from the Project Gutenberg 1908 edition restored at their matching passage anchors. The original, harsher ending is preserved in Full Classic Text.
